meta.study: Hammoud et al. — Avey AI symptom checker benchmark
meta.description: Complete merged dataset: 400 gold-standard clinical vignettes with full presentation, plus every symptom-checker and physician answer per case, plus Avey's per-case scoring metrics. Self-contained — each case object has everything.
meta.source: Scraped from avey.ai benchmark vignette suite; merged with the study results repo (github.com/rimads/avey-paper).

field_guide.case_number: case id (1-500 space; 400 present). Matches avey.ai URL and study result keys.
field_guide.diagnosis: full gold-standard diagnosis name; diagnosis_short is the study's abbreviated label.
field_guide.num_questions: number of interview questions in the reference session.
field_guide.vignette: the full clinical case: chief complaint, presentation (HPI), absent_findings, physical_examination, physical/family history. '-' means empty in source.
field_guide.gold_standard: the reference differential — differential_list is the ranked clean list.
field_guide.app_tests: raw answers from 6 checkers (Avey, Ada, Babylon, Buoy, K health, WebMD): result text, ddx_json, num_questions, and session_proofs (screenshot URLs).
field_guide.doctor_tests: raw answers from 3 anonymized GPs: ddx_json, result, duration, experience description.
field_guide.predictions_normalized: lowercased/cleaned diagnosis lists used for scoring. Keys: the 6 apps + MA=Dr. Mohmmad Almadani, TH=Dr. Tala Hammouri, NJ=Dr. Noor Joudeh.
field_guide.avey_metrics: Avey's per-case precision, recall, f1-score, NDCG, M1-M6 (match criteria), position (rank of correct dx), length (x of gs).
